fields.Name: T57 - Entity Form Create Forum Category
fields.Description: Verifies that a new Forum Category record can be created and saved through the entity form, confirming the create-and-save path works for the Forum Categories entity.

InputDefinition.goal: Navigate to Data Explorer and open the 'Forum Categories' entity from the entity tree. Click the New Record button to open a blank forum category form. Fill the Name field with 'Regression Test Forum', fill a Description, then click Save. Reach the state where the record is saved successfully (a save confirmation appears, or the new category shows in the grid). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait for loads and saves to finish rather than navigating away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A new forum category form was filled with Name 'Regression Test Forum' and a description
A save was performed and a save confirmation or saved-state indicator is visible
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
